For continuing distributor-part pairs: quantity contribution = (current quantity - prior quantity) x prior realised average price. Realised-price contribution = current quantity x (current average price - prior average price). Interaction is assigned to price. Entry/exit values complete the exact reconciliation.
Realised-price movement can reflect discounts, urgent-order charges and other conditions. It is not isolated list-price change, inflation or evidence of customer elasticity.
